name: Child reunification instructions
description: Record where children should go and who may pick them up if separated.
notes: Include school/daycare contacts and offline instructions.

name: Elder check-in schedule
description: Define how often elderly relatives or neighbors should be checked during an event.

name: Mobility assistance plan
description: Document mobility aids, ramps, transport needs, and lifting/transfer limitations.

name: Medication list
description: Track critical medication names, dosage schedule, refill dates, and packout location.
notes: Keep sensitive details private; use generic status outside household.

name: Medical device power plan
description: Record powered medical devices, battery runtime, chargers, adapters, and backup power priority.
notes: Tie this to the power readiness score.

name: Allergy and condition notes
description: Capture allergy, condition, or dietary notes needed during sheltering or evacuation.
notes: Use plain language and avoid over-sharing.

name: Pet carrier and leash
description: List carrier, leash, crate, muzzle, harness, and containment requirements.
notes: Keep carriers accessible during warning periods.

name: Pet food and water
description: Track pet food, water, bowls, medication, litter, waste bags, and comfort items.
notes: Include at least several days of supplies.

name: Service animal plan
description: Document service animal needs, access documents, relief schedule, food, and medical requirements.

name: Comfort and behavioral support
description: Plan comfort items, routines, noise sensitivity support, or calming strategies for dependents or pets.
notes: Useful for children, neurodivergent people, anxious pets, and stressful shelter environments.

name: Emergency document packet
description: Collect copies of IDs, medical cards, vaccination records, guardianship documents, and pet records.
notes: Store paper and encrypted digital copies.

name: Transportation assistance
description: Identify who needs help leaving and what vehicle, seat, crate, ramp, or equipment is required.
notes: Can become a needs/offers request if transport fails.

name: Backup caregiver
description: Name a second person who can care for each dependent or pet if the primary caregiver is unavailable.
notes: Verify that the backup has instructions and access.

name: Location sharing consent
description: Define who may see location or status details for each dependent during emergency or routine conditions.
notes: Use emergency-only sharing for sensitive cases.
